hint.p1: danger to people or the building
hint.p2: a home cannot be used normally

sla.title: Service levels
sla.intro: How fast requests are answered and fixed, against the society’s targets. Every number opens the requests behind it.
sla.illustrative: Illustrative targets: the society sets its own.
sla.emptyBody: No request is in this state now.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.intro: Repairs in flats and issues in shared places: what is open, who is on it and what is late.
maintenance.confirmationLine: {{confirmed}} confirmed fixed · {{reopened}} reopened · {{awaiting}} waiting for the resident

list.title: Maintenance requests
list.intro: One list for repairs in flats and issues in shared places.

request.publicHint: The resident sees this message in their app.
request.internalHint: Only the office sees this note. A technician or contractor sees only the notes shared with them.
request.closeEffect: The resident has not answered. The request closes as fixed and the resident is told; it can still be raised again as a new request.
request.cancelEffect: Any work order is cancelled and the resident is told.
request.assigneeHint: The office and the technician or contractor assigned to this job see this note. The resident does not.

next.label: Next step
next.submitted: New request: set its priority, then assign a technician.
next.triaged: Triaged: assign a technician and book the visit.
next.assigned: A technician is assigned and the visit is booked.
next.on_hold: On hold: see the work order for why.
next.awaitingResident: Fixed. Waiting for the resident to confirm or reopen it.
next.hidden: Hidden by a moderator: residents cannot see it.

closed.confirmed: Closed: the resident confirmed the fix.
closed.closed_by_office: Closed by the office after the resident did not answer.

reason.tenant_suspended: The organisation is suspended: history can be read, nothing can be changed.
reason.not_your_work_order: This work order is assigned to someone else.
reason.read_only: You can read this request; changing it needs maintenance management.

triage.title: Triage {{ref}}
triage.subtitle: Set the priority: it decides how fast the request must be answered and fixed.
triage.slaNote: Service levels follow the priority you choose.

assign.title: Assign {{ref}}
assign.subtitle: Choose who goes and when. The resident sees the technician’s name and the visit.
assign.notifies: The resident is told in the app as soon as you save.

complete.title: Finish {{ref}}
complete.subtitle: Say what was done and add a photo: the resident confirms or reopens it.
complete.subtitleIssue: Say what was done and add a photo; the manager then resolves the issue for residents.
complete.noteHint: At least a short sentence, in plain words.
complete.next: The resident is asked to confirm the fix in the app.
complete.issueNext: Residents are told when the manager resolves the issue.

hold.title: Put {{ref}} on hold
hold.hint: Waiting for parts, for access, for a supplier …

merge.title: Merge {{ref}} into another issue
merge.subtitle: Use this when residents reported the same problem twice.
merge.explain_one: {{count}} affected household moves to the issue you choose; it keeps counting there.
merge.explain_other: {{count}} affected households move to the issue you choose; they keep counting there.
merge.none: There is no other open issue to merge into.

issue.hideEffect: Residents no longer see it (the resident who raised it sees that it was hidden). Staff still see it.
issue.resolveSubtitle: Write what residents will read. Everyone who said it affects them and every follower is told.
issue.summaryHint: Plain words, no names. Residents see this, not internal notes.
issue.liveLine_one: {{count}} household of {{audience}} on the site said it affects them.
issue.liveLine_other: {{count}} households of {{audience}} on the site said it affects them.
issue.staffOnly: Names and live counts are for staff only.

notShown.below_threshold: “Reported” (too few households to show a number)
notShown.audience_too_small: “Reported” (the group is too small to show a number)

issue.privacyRule: Residents see a number only for 3 or more households out of at least 5, and only when no other number they see could be subtracted from it. Numbers change only at the daily refresh, and only by 3 or more.

issues.title: Community issues
issues.intro: Problems in shared places that several households report. The same request model as repairs; the people affected stay private.
issues.privacyBody: Residents see “Reported” until at least {{count}} households out of {{audience}} or more say it affects them, in fixed groups (the site, or a block). They never see who.

board.title: Technician board
board.intro: Every technician’s open work orders, soonest visit first.
board.myIntro: Your open work orders. Open one to start, pause or finish it.

confirm.title: Resident confirmation
confirm.intro: After a repair the resident confirms it was fixed, or reopens it. Requests waiting longest come first.

explain.awaiting: Marked as fixed; the resident has not answered yet. After 3 days the office may close it for them, with a reason.
explain.reopened: The resident said it was not fixed: the same technician goes back on a new work order.
explain.confirmed: Closed by the resident’s confirmation, or by the office when the resident did not answer.

confirm.emptyBody: No repair is in this state.

new.title: New request
new.intro: Raise a request for a flat or a shared place (a phone call, a walk-in, something the guard saw).

photo.altHint: A few words for people who cannot see the photo.
photo.demoNote: Demo: the photo stays in this browser; it is not uploaded anywhere.

errors.fileType: Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
errors.fileSize: The photo is larger than 5 MB.
errors.flatNotYours: Choose a flat you live in or own.
errors.dateInPast: Choose today or a later date.
errors.noWhatsappConsent: You have not agreed to WhatsApp messages: change it in your profile or choose another way.
errors.workOrderClosed: This work order is already finished or cancelled.
errors.wrongStep: This step is not possible now (someone may have changed it). Refresh to see where it stands.
errors.evidenceNeeded: Add a photo of the finished work.
errors.notLinked: This person is not living in or owning that flat.
errors.notYourBlock: That place belongs to another block.
errors.nobodyHome: Nobody lives in this flat to ask. Call the office.
errors.alreadyAsked: This visitor is already waiting for an answer.
errors.denied: The resident said no: the visitor cannot come in.
errors.notApproved: No resident has said yes yet.
errors.alreadyAdmitted: This visitor was already let in.
errors.onlyOccupants: Only people who live in the flat can do this.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number with 10 to 13 digits.
errors.plate: Enter a number plate like LEC 1234.
errors.window: The visit must end after it starts.
errors.windowTooFar: Choose a visit within the next 30 days.
errors.windowSingle: A single visit can last up to 24 hours.
errors.windowMultiple: A pass for several visits can last up to 31 days.
errors.requestExpired: Too late: the request expired and the visitor was turned away.
errors.alreadyDecided: Someone in your home already answered.
errors.audienceRoles: Choose owners, occupants or liable payers.
errors.scheduleFuture: Choose a time in the future.
errors.noticeClosed: A withdrawn or expired notice cannot change.
errors.noAckNeeded: This notice does not ask for an acknowledgement.
errors.plateAlreadyYours: This vehicle is already registered for your flat.
errors.slot: Choose a free parking slot of this flat.
errors.moveDate: Choose a date within 30 days before or 90 days after today.
errors.notOccupant: This person does not live in the flat on the day before that date.
errors.bookingDate: Choose a day within the next 30 days.
errors.slotTaken: That time is already booked. Choose another.
errors.merchantId: Use a sandbox merchant ID that starts with DEMO-.
errors.residentsOnlyBook: Only the people who live in the flat can book this amenity.
errors.noAssignee: No one is assigned to this job yet.

notInPlan.title: Not available for your home
notInPlan.body: This part of the app is not switched on for your building, or you are no longer linked to a flat here. Contact the society office if you think this is wrong.

repairs.title: Repairs
repairs.intro: Report a problem in your flat and follow it until it is fixed.
repairs.cannotRaise: Repairs are reported by the people who live in or own the flat.
repairs.sharedPlace: A problem in a shared place (lift, water, gate)?
repairs.emptyBody: When you report a repair you can follow it here.
repairs.visitBooked: {{name}} will visit (the office will confirm the time)
repairs.confirmPrompt: Tell us if it is fixed
repairs.newSubtitle: Takes a minute. The office answers within the service level of its priority.
repairs.describeHint: What you see, since when, and anything the technician should know.
repairs.emergencyTitle: In a real emergency, call first
repairs.emergencyBody: For fire, gas or a danger to people, call the guard room and emergency services. This form is not watched around the clock.
repairs.contact: How should the office reach you?
repairs.notFound: This repair is not one of yours, or it is no longer linked to your flat.
repairs.confirmed: Thank you. The repair is closed.

hub.title: Requests
hub.intro: Everything you ask of the building: repairs, issues, visitors, vehicles and bookings.

visitors.onlyOccupantsTitle: Only people who live here invite guests
visitors.onlyOccupantsBody: You are linked to a flat you do not live in. The people who live there invite their guests.
visitors.noLiveQueue: The gate does not ask residents about visitors without a pass in this building.
visitors.asked: Visitors the gate asked you about
visitors.inviteSubtitle: The guest shows the code at the gate within the time you choose.
visitors.name: Guest’s name
visitors.phoneHint: Only the guard sees it, to call if needed.
visitors.plateHint: If the guest comes by car.
visitors.multipleHint: The code works every day within the dates (a cook, a driver, a nurse).
visitors.showCode: The guest shows this code at the gate
visitors.copied: Copied. Paste it into a message to your guest.
visitors.shareText: {{name}}, you are invited to Al-Noor Residency, flat {{flat}}. Show code {{code}} at the gate between {{from}} and {{to}}.
visitors.simulated: Demo: codes are checked by the mock gate; no real gate system is connected.

refusal.not_yet_valid: The pass is not valid yet.
refusal.host_not_resident: The host no longer lives in this flat.
refusal.other_site: The pass is for another site.

refusalHelp.unknown_code: Check the code with the visitor, or ask the resident through the queue.
refusalHelp.expired: Ask the resident to send a new pass, or ask them through the queue.
refusalHelp.not_yet_valid: The visit starts later. The visitor can wait, or you can ask the resident through the queue.
refusalHelp.already_used: A single-visit pass works once. Ask the resident through the queue.
refusalHelp.cancelled: Ask the resident through the queue if the visitor insists.
refusalHelp.denied_by_resident: Do not let the visitor in.
refusalHelp.request_expired: Ask again if the visitor is still waiting.
refusalHelp.host_not_resident: Call the office: the person who invited the visitor has moved out.
refusalHelp.other_site: This pass is not for this gate.

gate.title: Gate check-in
gate.intro: Check a visitor’s code, ask residents about visitors without a pass, and check people out.
gate.codeHint: 6 digits, from the visitor’s phone or a printed pass.
gate.doNotLetIn: Do not let the visitor in
gate.withoutPassHint: The people who live in the flat are asked in their app. Only their yes lets the visitor in.
gate.noLiveQueue: This building does not ask residents at the gate: visitors need a pass.
gate.simulatedQueue: Simulated: the queue refreshes in this browser; there is no live security service.
gate.promptBody: {{name}} ({{purpose}}) is at the gate. {{guard}} is asking if they can come in.
gate.call: Ask the guard to call me
gate.simulated: Demo: in a real building this would be an alert on your phone.
gate.tooLate: Too late: this request was already answered or expired.

answered.call: The guard will call you about {{name}}

visitorDash.title: Visitors and the gate
visitorDash.intro: Who is expected, who is inside, and what the gate is waiting on.
visitorDash.simulated: Demo data: no real gate system is connected.

passes.title: Visitor passes
passes.intro: Every pass residents created, with its window and use.
passes.search: Search name, code, flat or vehicle
passes.hostLeft: The person who invited this visitor no longer lives in the flat: the gate refuses the pass.

history.title: Visitor history
history.intro: Every arrival at the gate: who, for which flat, when they came and left, and who was not let in.
history.search: Search name, flat, vehicle or reference

scan.title: Scan a pass
scan.intro: Scan the code on the visitor’s phone. The same check as typing the code.
scan.simulated: The prototype never opens a camera. Pick a demo pass below as if you scanned it.

notices.title: Notices
notices.intro: Official notices to owners, occupants or liable payers: who received, read and acknowledged them.
notices.noAddon: Notices need no community add-on: they come with the residents register and the resident app.
notices.composeSubtitle: One-way and on the record: residents read it, they do not reply.
notices.bodyHint: Plain words. Never name a resident or anyone’s dues here.
notices.askAckLong: Ask residents to acknowledge they have read it
notices.inAppAlways: Every resident in the audience gets it in the app. Copies by text message or WhatsApp are simulated and only go to people who agreed to them.
notices.expires: Remove from the current list after
notices.versionBody: Your change is saved as a new version. Residents see the new text with “Updated on”, and acknowledgements of the earlier version no longer count.
notices.withdrawEffect: Residents see only that it was withdrawn and when. Its notifications are withdrawn too. Nothing is deleted.
notices.tombstone: Residents see only that it was withdrawn, with the date.
notices.statsLine: {{noApp}} without the app (message copies only where agreed) · {{sms}} text messages and {{whatsapp}} WhatsApp messages simulated · {{left}} no longer in the audience
notices.staffOnly: Staff only: residents never see who has or has not acknowledged.
notices.scheduleSimulated: Demo: there is no background job. A scheduled notice is published the first time anyone opens notices after its time (simulated scheduler).

audience.title: Who receives it
audience.chooseFirst: Choose where and who to see who it reaches.

message.title: Quick message
message.intro: A short one-way message to residents (water off, lift stopped). Post it as an official notice too if it should stay on record.
message.alsoNotice: Also post it as an official notice
message.sentLine: {{inApp}} in the app · {{sms}} text messages and {{whatsapp}} WhatsApp messages (simulated) · {{skipped}} skipped without consent · {{noApp}} without the app
message.oneWay: One way: residents cannot reply. Text messages and WhatsApp messages are simulated.
message.totals: {{recipients}} people · {{inApp}} in the app · {{sms}} texts · {{whatsapp}} WhatsApp

residentNotice.title: Notices
residentNotice.intro: Official notices from the society office.
residentNotice.withdrawnBody: The society office withdrew it on {{date}}. Its text is no longer shown.
residentNotice.notAvailable: This notice is not available to you

notAvailableBody.not_in_audience: It was sent to a different group of residents, or you are no longer linked to a flat it was for.

residentNotice.ackAsk: The office asks you to confirm you have read this notice.
residentNotice.acked: Thank you. The office can see you read it.
residentNotice.oneWay: Notices are one way: replies are not possible here. Contact the society office if you have a question.
residentNotice.offlineList: You are offline. This is the list as it was loaded at {{time}}.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.simulated: Text and WhatsApp copies are simulated; this list is what the app shows.

notify.passCancelled: The office cancelled the pass for {{name}}

residentIssue.title: Community issues
residentIssue.intro: Problems in shared places: report one, or say it affects you too. Nobody sees who else is affected.
residentIssue.privacy: Counts appear only when enough households are affected, and refresh once a day; nobody sees who.

empty.mine: You have not reported or followed any issue.

residentIssue.withdrawn: Removed: it no longer affects you
residentIssue.raiseSubtitle: Shared places only. You are counted as affected; others can say it affects them too.
residentIssue.similarHint: If it is the same problem, open it and say it affects you too instead.
residentIssue.describeHint: No names of neighbours, please: describe the problem, not people.
residentIssue.youCount: Your household is counted as affected. Others never see that it was you.
residentIssue.notFound: This issue is not one you can see (it may be for another block).
residentIssue.privacyShort: Your name is never shown to other residents.
residentIssue.commentHint: Comments are moderated. Do not name neighbours.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.intro: Register your car or motorbike: the office approves it and gives it a slot.
vehicles.onlyOccupants: Vehicles are registered by the people who live in the flat.
vehicles.emptyBody: Registered vehicles get a sticker and a parking slot.
vehicles.pendingHint: Sent on {{date}}: waiting for the office to approve.
vehicles.addSubtitle: The office checks the number plate and your flat, then approves it.
vehicles.approvalNote: A number plate can be approved for one flat only. Approval is not automatic.

parking.title: Parking
parking.intro: Your household’s parking slots and the rules of the car park.

rules.sticker: Every car needs the society sticker on the windscreen.
rules.visitor: Visitors park in the visitor bays only, with a pass.
rules.noBlocking: Never block another slot, the ramp or the gate.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.intro: Book the gym, the community hall or the rooftop. Some bookings need the office’s approval.

rule.gym1: Sports shoes only; wipe the machines after use.
rule.kids1: Children with an adult at all times.
rule.hall2: The booking household is responsible for cleaning.
rule.bbq1: Gas cylinders are not allowed on the roof.

amenities.requestNote: The office approves or declines; you are told in the app.
amenities.instantNote: Confirmed at once if the slot is free.
amenities.feeNote: A fee of {{amount}} applies (illustrative; it is billed with your dues, never paid here).
amenities.residentsOnly: Only the people who live in the flat can book this.

gateway.sandboxBody: This connects to a demo gateway in test mode. No real card, wallet or bank details are taken, and no money moves.
gateway.merchantHint: Sandbox merchant IDs start with DEMO-.
gateway.readOnly: Only someone who manages the merchant account can change these settings.
gateway.notPaid: A gateway event never marks a bill as paid. A payment counts only once its bank statement line is matched.
gateway.testBody: Pretend the gateway is telling us a payment succeeded, and see what the society’s books do with it.
gateway.eventIdHint: Send an earlier ID again to see a duplicate refused.

vehicleOffice.title: Vehicle register
vehicleOffice.intro: Residents’ cars and motorbikes: approve new ones into a free slot, and remove the ones no longer parked here.
vehicleOffice.rule: A plate can be approved for one flat only, and only into a free slot of that flat.
vehicleOffice.emptyPendingBody: New vehicles that residents register appear here.
vehicleOffice.emptyBody: Try another status or clear the search.
vehicleOffice.notFound: This vehicle is not in the register.
vehicleOffice.readOnly: You can see the register. Approving and removing vehicles is not part of your role.
vehicleOffice.featureOff: Vehicle approvals are not in your plan, so new vehicles cannot be approved here.

checks.title: Before you approve
checks.plateOk: No other approved vehicle has this plate.
checks.plateDuplicate: This plate is already approved for flat {{flat}} ({{ref}}).
checks.pendingSame_one: {{count}} other request for the same plate is also waiting.
checks.pendingSame_other: {{count}} other requests for the same plate are also waiting.
checks.linkEnded: {{name}} no longer lives in or owns {{flat}}.
checks.allowanceOk: Slots of the flat in use: {{used}} of {{allowance}}.
checks.allowanceFull: Every slot of the flat is in use: {{used}} of {{allowance}}.
checks.noFreeSlot: The flat has no free slot.

cannot.title: This vehicle cannot be approved
cannot.duplicate_plate: Another flat already has this plate approved. Reject this request with a reason, or remove the other vehicle first if it was sold.
cannot.link_ended: The person who registered it no longer lives in or owns the flat. Reject it with a reason.
cannot.allowance_full: Every slot of the flat is taken. Remove a vehicle the household no longer parks here, or reject this one.
cannot.not_pending: This vehicle has already been decided.
cannot.suspended: The workspace is suspended: you can read the register but not decide.

vehicleOffice.slotHint: One of the flat’s free slots.
vehicleOffice.rejectReasonHint: The resident sees this. At least 10 characters.
vehicleOffice.retireHint: When the vehicle is sold or no longer parked here. Its slot becomes free and the resident is told.

refusal.duplicate_plate: Another flat already has this plate approved.
refusal.link_ended: The owner no longer lives in or owns the flat.
refusal.allowance_full: Every slot of the flat is taken.
refusal.not_pending: This vehicle has already been decided.

home.repairBody: Tell the office whether it is really fixed, or send it back.
home.noticeBody: The office asks every household to confirm they have read it.

residentsOffice.title: Residents
residentsOffice.intro: Who lives where, and what residents are waiting on from the office: repairs, visitors, vehicles, notices and bookings.
residentsOffice.bookingsIntro: Requests waiting for your decision, and approved bookings still to come. The resident is told in the app.
residentsOffice.onlyManagers: Only staff who manage amenities can approve or decline bookings.
residentsOffice.noBookings: No booking requests and no approved bookings to come.
residentsOffice.declineSubtitle: The resident sees your reason in the app.
residentsOffice.declineHint: At least 10 characters, for example why the place is not available that day.

move.title: Record a move-out
move.subtitle: The day someone stops living in a flat. Who pays and who is invited to the app do not change.
move.noOccupant: Nobody lives in this flat now, so there is no move-out to record.
move.dateHint: From 30 days ago up to 90 days ahead.
move.reasonHint: For example: lease ended, flat sold, moved abroad. At least 5 characters.
move.ruleTitle: A move does not change who pays
move.ruleBody: If the person moving out is responsible for paying, they stay responsible until the payer is changed. App access and invitations are not touched.
move.stillLiableBody: A move never changes who pays for the flat. If someone else should pay from now on, change the payer: that is a separate step with its own approval.
move.appNote: Nothing was sent to the resident, and their app access is unchanged: review it in Resident app access if needed.

flatServices.emptyBody: Your role does not include this flat’s repairs, visitors, vehicles or moves.
flatServices.noPasses: No visitor passes for this flat.
flatServices.noMoves: No moves recorded for this flat.
